title: Engineering Manager (Web Platform)
description:
Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Bitwarden makes it easy for all users to extend robust security across their devices with password management, secrets management, and passwordless and passkey innovations. The company is headquartered in Santa Barbara, California with team members located across the globe. Learn more at bitwarden.com.
   

  

**About the Role**
 As we establish our India Engineering Center of Excellence (COE), we are looking for an experienced
 **Engineering Manager** 
 who can lead and grow the Web Platform team. As the Engineering Manager for the Web Platform team, you will be expected to lead a team of experienced software engineers responsible for the core web application tooling and client services that support all of our web\-based clients. This includes our web application, Electron\-based desktop client, browser extension, and CLI, as well as other clients and additional Products in the future. You will be expected to work closely with other managers and teams across the organization to understand their needs for ongoing feature development, anticipate future needs, and ensure the ongoing stability and security of the platforms.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Hire, develop, and retain a strong team of engineers
* Set and report on measurable goals and objectives for the team
* Facilitate team ceremonies including weekly syncs, backlog refinements, retrospectives, and sprint planning
* Monitor in\-flight work to identify blocked items, proactively drive resolution, and provide contextual updates outside of the team to the rest of the organization
* Own escalation and triage for production issues, community\-reported bugs, and enterprise customer escalations related to autofill behavior and desktop integrations
* Maintain a healthy, sprint\-ready backlog by prioritizing bugs and tech debt alongside feature work and ensuring all items are well\-defined with accurate descriptions, technical breakdowns, and designs prior to refinement
* Serve as the primary liaison between your engineering team and Design, Product, Architecture, and other engineering teams, fielding cross\-functional questions and maintaining alignment on priorities
* Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization to synthesize requests into prioritized, actionable work
* Continuously identify friction points in team processes and develop solutions to improve efficiency, quality, and developer experience
* Create an inclusive environment where teamwork and collaboration are valued
* Conduct regular 1:1s, develop individualized performance goals and growth plans, and identify stretch opportunities to support each engineer's career progression
* Perform annual or semi\-annual performance reviews when required


**What You'll Bring**
* 10\-12 years of demonstrated experience leading engineering teams or complex cross\-functional product engineering initiatives within a software engineering organization.
* Experience working in globally distributed Product Engineering, GCC, or Center of Excellence environments along with managing distributed or cross\-regional teams, including working across time zones.
* Proven ability to successfully lead delivery across engineering organizations and influence multiple stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of Agile software development, modern engineering practices, and product delivery lifecycles.
* Experience in Engineering Management, Technical Program Management, Engineering Delivery, Product Operations, Design Program Management, or similar leadership roles.
* Ability to communicate effectively with Engineering, Product, Design, and executive stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving, prioritization, and decision\-making skills with a continuous improvement mindset.
* A coaching\-oriented leadership style with demonstrated experience developing high\-performing teams.
* Strong technical background in CI/CD, automation \& release engineering \- sufficient to engage credibly in technical discussions and step in hands\-on when necessary.
* Excellent communication skills, with experience representing a team's work to leadership and stakeholders outside the team.
* Prior experience managing or working closely with BRE, SRE, DevOps, or Platform Engineering teams.
* Formal management training or certifications preferred.
* Experience with specific tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar project management platforms preferred with AI tooling for development and workflow support (Claude Code or similar).


**Success in This Role**
 You'll thrive in this position if you:
   

  

* Lead through influence, collaboration, and trust.
* Bring structure without introducing unnecessary processes.
* Balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Create clarity across complex, cross\-functional initiatives.
* Enjoy building teams, developing people, and enabling engineering excellence.
* Are energized by helping establish and scale a world\-class Engineering organization.


**Why Join Us**
 This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up.
   

  

 Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations.
   

  

 Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization \& contribute to products used by customers around the world.
   

  

 If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast\-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

**Equal Opportunity Employer**
 We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

title: Global Product Senior Analyst
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 The HR Digital Product Portfolio is one of the largest and most dynamic portfolios within BCG’s Digital Products Organization, enabling technology across BCG’s HR and People functions. Within the Talent Acquisition Product Team, the Candidate Selection squad supports the products and capabilities that underpin how BCG assesses and selects candidates.
   

  

 As a Senior Product Analyst, you will work closely with the Product Owner, business teams, technology teams, QA, and external vendors to shape effective product solutions. You will independently explore business needs, challenge assumptions, and translate complex requirements into clear, actionable solutions, with the Product Owner providing direction and final sign\-off where appropriate.
   

  

* Lead and facilitate requirements discussions with business and technology teams to understand problems, user needs, business value, and the wider impact of proposed changes.
* Document clear product requirements in Jira, translating business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, use cases, and solution options.
* Challenge requests constructively, identifying assumptions, dependencies, risks, unintended consequences, and alternative approaches before solutions are agreed.
* Co\-create solutions with business, technology, QA, and vendor teams, helping bridge functional and technical considerations and supporting the Product Owner with prioritization and delivery readiness.
* Build deep product knowledge and take accountability for changes from requirements through test\-scenario definition, validation, deployment readiness, and rollout.
* Prioritize and investigate assigned production issues, identify likely root causes, and bring the right squad, vendor, or technology expertise together to drive effective resolution.
* Support successful adoption of new functionality by preparing release notes and partnering with Learning and Development and Process Enablement colleagues on user guidance and learning materials where needed.
* Contribute to cross\-functional initiatives and broader Talent Acquisition Product Team priorities as opportunities and business needs evolve.
* Build adjacent product and technical skills, including taking on straightforward SaaS configuration and functional enhancement activities where appropriate.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 4\+ years of relevant experience in product analysis, business analysis, technology, operations, or a related field.
* Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills, with confidence to challenge assumptions, identify downstream impacts, and recommend practical solutions.
* Experience eliciting, translating, and documenting business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, functional requirements, and use cases.
* Experience partnering with developers and engineers to bridge functional and technical requirements and translate business intent into implementation\-ready specifications.
* Experience partnering with QA teams to define test scenarios, validate system behaviour, investigate issues, and manage feedback through delivery.
* Experience working with SaaS products and external vendors, with an interest in developing hands\-on configuration and product administration capabilities.
* Strong working knowledge of Jira and Confluence; Talent Acquisition or HR technology experience is strongly preferred, while exposure to ServiceNow, APIs, integrations, MuleSoft, production support, system troubleshooting, or change management is beneficial.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

 You’ll be part of the Candidate Selection squad within BCG’s global Talent Acquisition Product Team.
   

  

 You’ll collaborate closely with Product Owners, engineers, developers, QA, Scrum Leads, SaaS Engineers, Talent Acquisition teams, and external vendors. Depending on the product or change, you may also partner with Legal, Data Protection, and Responsible AI teams.
   

  

 The team works through close business and technology co\-creation, combining BCG\-built solutions with integrated SaaS platforms and strong vendor partnerships across a global network.
   

  

 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
   

  

 BCG is an E \- Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E\-Verify.

title: Lead Solution Expert
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
   

  

 As a
 **Lead Solution Expert (Mendix)** 
 , you will lead the design, development, and delivery of scalable low\-code applications using the Mendix platform. You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to translate business requirements into innovative digital solutions that support Siemens Energy's transformation initiatives.
   

  

 In this role, you will provide technical leadership across the application lifecycle, mentor developers, drive Agile delivery practices, and ensure solutions meet enterprise standards for security, scalability, performance, and maintainability. You will also play a key role in shaping technical architecture and fostering best practices within the Mendix development community.
   

  

 How You'll Make an Impact
   

  

* Lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise\-grade applications using the Mendix low\-code platform.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to development teams on Mendix best practices, coding standards, governance, and platform capabilities.
* Partner with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and translate requirements into technical specifications, solution designs, and user stories.
* Drive Agile delivery processes, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand\-ups, and release planning.
* Conduct architecture reviews and code reviews to ensure compliance with security, quality, and performance standards.
* Own and oversee the complete application lifecycle, from solution design through deployment and production support.
* Ensure application reliability through robust testing, quality assurance, and performance optimization practices.
* Manage issue resolution, bug fixes, enhancements, and change requests while maintaining strong stakeholder communication.
* Lead client discussions, technical workshops, design\-thinking sessions, and solution demonstrations.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to integrate Mendix applications with enterprise systems and cloud platforms.


 What You Bring
   

  

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 6\-8 years of overall software development experience, including significant hands\-on expertise with the Mendix low\-code platform.
* Mendix Advanced Certified Developer certification (mandatory).
* Proven experience leading development teams and delivering projects in Agile/Scrum environments.
* Strong expertise in:
+ Mendix domain modeling
+ Microflows and business logic implementation
+ Forms, pages, and user experience development
+ Application performance optimization

* Experience building and consuming app services within Mendix applications.
* Hands\-on experience with:
+ JavaScript
+ CSS
+ HTML
+ XPath

* Experience developing Java actions and integrating external web services.
* Strong understanding of:
+ SQL and database concepts
+ Model\-Driven Development (MDD)
+ Agile/Scrum methodologies

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Mendix Native Mobile development.
* Knowledge of REST APIs, microservices, and modern application architecture patterns.
* Experience integrating Mendix applications with enterprise systems.
* Exposure to cloud technologies, including Microsoft Azure and AWS.
* Experience working in large\-scale global enterprise environments.


 Key Competencies
   

  

* Technical Leadership
* Solution Architecture
* Agile Project Delivery
* Stakeholder Management
* Application Governance
* Team Mentoring \& Coaching
* Critical Thinking \& Problem Solving
* Communication \& Collaboration
* Quality \& Continuous Improvement


**About The Team**
 Our
 **Global Functions** 
 organization plays a critical role in driving Siemens Energy's central initiatives and ensuring operational excellence across business areas, regions, and manufacturing units.
   

  

 As part of this team, you will contribute directly to our vision of becoming the world's most valued energy technology company. You will help accelerate the global energy transition by enabling resilient, secure, and digitally advanced business operations while ensuring compliance with legal, regulatory, and corporate standards.
   

  

 Who Is Siemens Energy?
   

  

 At Siemens Energy, we are more than an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across more than 90 countries while helping to protect the environment and support a sustainable future.
   

  

 With over 100,000 employees worldwide, we are driving innovation across the energy landscape through decarbonization initiatives, digital transformation, and advanced technologies. Backed by more than 150 years of engineering excellence, our diverse global workforce is committed to creating reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy solutions for generations to come.

title: Manager - Ecommerce transformation
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Consulting \- Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The Manager \- Ecommerce Transformation will drive ecommerce transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining digital commerce strategy, customer experience improvement, operating model design, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in improving online growth, commerce operations, product discovery, conversion, order experience, and omnichannel effectiveness. You will work with business and technology stakeholders to shape commerce roadmaps, design scalable operating models, and implement transformation initiatives that improve revenue realization, digital adoption, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Business Development \& Market Leadership
+ Support ecommerce transformation pipeline development across advisory, implementation, and managed transformation opportunities.
+ Contribute to proposals, RFP responses, business cases, demos, and executive presentations focused on digital commerce growth and operational improvement.
+ Support GTM strategies for ecommerce transformation offerings across B2B, B2C, and marketplace\-led business models.
+ Design and refine commerce transformation offerings aligned with client priorities, including digital channel growth, product data improvement, checkout optimization, and omnichannel enablement.
+ Contribute to thought leadership, client workshops, and points of view on ecommerce trends, digital buying behaviour, platform modernization, and commerce operating model evolution.


* Client Engagement \& Delivery
+ Lead ecommerce transformation workstreams from current\-state assessment through strategy, roadmap design, implementation planning, and execution support.
+ Assess commerce journeys, digital storefronts, product information flows, merchandising processes, search and navigation, order management touchpoints, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
+ Design ecommerce operating models, governance structures, product data processes, merchandising workflows, channel strategies, and performance management frameworks.
+ Support initiatives across product discovery, catalog readiness, personalization, pricing and promotions, cart and checkout, order visibility, returns experience, and customer support integration.
+ Partner with product, technology, data, marketing, sales, and operations teams to translate commerce priorities into structured requirements, process flows, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
+ Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify conversion improvement, revenue uplift, digital adoption, cost\-to\-serve reduction, and operational productivity gains.
+ Ensure delivery excellence across assigned workstreams, including scope, timeline, budget, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder alignment.
+ Support change management, adoption, and governance activities to embed sustainable commerce capabilities across business teams.


* Technology \& Innovation
+ Enable teams to leverage ecommerce platforms, product information management systems, order management systems, CRM, analytics, personalization tools, automation, and AI\-enabled insights.
+ Stay ahead of technology trends shaping ecommerce transformation, including composable commerce, headless architecture, AI\-enabled product discovery, personalization, digital shelf analytics, and omnichannel orchestration.
+ Identify opportunities to develop reusable accelerators for commerce journey assessment, product data maturity, conversion diagnostics, and benefits tracking.


* Leadership \& People Development
+ Manage project teams or workstreams and ensure high\-quality delivery across ecommerce transformation engagements.
+ Mentor consultants and analysts on ecommerce strategy, requirements structuring, delivery governance, and cross\-functional stakeholder management.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Demonstrate knowledge of digital commerce capabilities, including B2B and B2C commerce, marketplace models, dealer and distributor portals, and subscription commerce.
* Have exposure to leading commerce platforms and ecosystems, including Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce, Shopify, SAP Commerce Cloud, commerce tools, BigCommerce, Akeneo, Salsify, and similar technologies.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in ecommerce transformation, digital commerce, omnichannel strategy, customer experience, product data transformation, or commerce operations.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading ecommerce transformation programs, digital channel improvement initiatives, or commerce operating model redesign.
* Strong understanding of ecommerce journeys, digital merchandising, product information management, order experience, conversion optimization, and commerce performance metrics.
* Hands\-on experience with ecommerce platforms, analytics tools, PIM, OMS, CRM, or related digital commerce technologies.
* Strong business development support, stakeholder management, communication, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment:** 
 As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

 Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture:** 
 In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits:** 
 Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply:** 
 If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

**Consulting –** 
**Manager\- Customer Service Transformation and AI**
**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.

The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 The
 **Manager – Customer Service Transformation and AI** 
 will drive AI\-led service transformation initiatives within the Customer practice, combining service strategy, AI solution design, process improvement, and delivery excellence. The role will support clients in reimagining service journeys, contact centre operations, field service, and knowledge\-enabled support models through responsible use of AI, automation, analytics, and workflow orchestration. You will work with senior stakeholders to identify transformation opportunities, shape practical roadmaps, and deliver measurable improvements in customer experience, service productivity, resolution quality, and operating efficiency.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Support the development of AI\-led service transformation opportunities across advisory and implementation engagements, contributing to pipeline growth and client relationship expansion.

* Develop reusable assets, accelerators, and points of view on AI\-led service transformation, customer operations, and service experience modernization.

**Client Engagement \& Delivery**
* Lead workstreams within service transformation programs from current\-state assessment through roadmap design, implementation planning, and adoption support.
* Assess service processes, customer journeys, operating models, channel mix, agent workflows, knowledge management practices, and performance metrics to identify improvement opportunities.
* Design AI\-enabled service operating models, service blueprints, automation use cases, governance structures, and adoption roadmaps aligned to client business outcomes.
* Support implementation of AI use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, sentiment insights, knowledge search, predictive service, and workflow automation.

* Develop business cases and benefits models to quantify productivity gains, containment improvement, average handle time reduction, service quality improvement, and cost\-to\-serve impact.

**Technology \& Innovation**

* Work with cross\-functional teams to define data, integration, and governance considerations required for AI\-enabled service transformation.
* Identify opportunities to build accelerators, prototypes, and reusable methods for AI\-enabled service discovery, solution design, and benefits tracking.


**Leadership \& People Development**

* Coach consultants and analysts on service transformation methods, requirements structuring, stakeholder engagement, and AI\-led operating model design.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Ideally, you’ll also**
* Experience with AI\-enabled service use cases such as virtual agents, agent assist, intelligent routing, case summarization, and predictive service insights.
* Exposure to service platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Customer Service, ServiceNow CSM, Genesys, NICE, Amazon Connect, or similar technologies.
* Industry experience across B2B, professional services, technology, manufacturing, consumer, healthcare, utilities, or financial services sectors.


**What We Look For**
* 8\+ years of experience in service transformation, customer operations, contact center transformation, field service transformation, digital service, or AI\-enabled operations improvement.
* Consulting experience is desired.
* Proven experience supporting or leading service transformation initiatives from assessment through implementation planning and adoption.
* Strong understanding of service journeys, contact center operations, case management, knowledge management, service KPIs, and customer experience improvement levers.
* Hands\-on experience with AI, automation, analytics, CRM, service platforms, or digital workflow tools in customer service environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, problem\-solving, and project delivery skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
   

  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

 Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.

**Job Description**
 Delivery Coach / Scrum Master — Salesforce (Primary) \& NetSuite (Secondary)
   

  

**Overview**
 We are seeking an experienced Delivery Coach / Scrum Master to lead delivery, primarily for our Salesforce team (approximately 90% of the role), with the remaining 10% supporting the NetSuite team. In this role you will act as a servant\-leader, facilitating Scrum ceremonies, coaching the team on Agile (and other) principles, and creating the conditions for high, sustainable delivery. You will remove impediments, protect the team's focus, and foster a culture of transparency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate combines strong facilitation and coaching skills with familiarity with the Salesforce delivery landscape.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Serve as the primary Scrum Master for the Salesforce team (\~90% of the role), facilitating all core Scrum ceremonies.

* Coach both teams on Agile and Scrum practices, driving continuous improvement.
* Facilitate retrospectives that surface honest insights and produce concrete, tracked improvement actions.
* Identify, track, and remove impediments that block progress across the Salesforce and NetSuite teams.
* Protect the teams from external disruption and help maintain a sustainable pace.
* Partner with product owners to keep backlogs healthy, refined, and well\-prioritised.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies, especially where Salesforce and NetSuite integrate.
* Maintain transparent reporting on sprint health, delivery metrics, and progress for stakeholders.


**Required Skills \& Experience**
* Solid, demonstrable understanding of Agile principles and the Scrum framework.
* Proven experience facilitating Scrum ceremonies and coaching delivery teams.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and conflict\-resolution skills.
* Effective stakeholder management across technical and business audiences.
* Ability to remove impediments and promote team self\-organisation.
* Proficiency with an Agile work\-tracking tool and delivery reporting.

* 3–5 years in a Scrum Master role.
* Experience supporting Salesforce delivery teams or projects.
* Exposure to NetSuite projects or ERP delivery.

 Tools \& Systems
   

  

* Salesforce — primary supported platform (\~90%).

* Ceremony effectiveness: well\-facilitated, outcome\-focused Scrum events across both teams.
* Impediment resolution: blockers identified and resolved in a timely manner.
* Delivery predictability: consistent achievement of sprint commitments and stable flow.
* Cross\-platform coordination: Salesforce/NetSuite dependencies managed smoothly.
